.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/{gates/render,gates/constraints,scored/functional,scored/polish,scored/visual}/prompt.md, gates/*/judge.toml, scoring.toml, test.sh, tools/ (diffed against the task)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/task/instruction.md and environment/instructions/{ui,policy,overview,integration,security}.md (editor-surface, no-sign-in, shared-library and CDN statements)
evidence:
REAL GATE. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 '[gates] render = 0.0 constraints = 0.0'; both gate judge.toml files use 'aggregation = "all_pass"' with binary criteria. test.sh and tools/ are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty); test.sh:213-221 runs the gates suite, then score.py, and 'case 1) exit 0' ends before the scored suite, and score.py:48 'reward = round(weighted, 4) if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0'. Render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:23, cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing): 'Fails if the page is blank or shows only an error, if no code editing area is shown, if the typed word does not appear in the editor, or if the workspace does not load again after the reload'; prompt.md:5 'A blank page, a generic error, an unavailable server, or a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into fails.' Server-backing leg is in the constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:32, cw_shared_saved_record): Save, 'clear this origin's browser storage ... and reload the page, so nothing held only in the browser survives', re-find and confirm exact title, filename and source, reload again; it starts from a successful Save (positive control) and a browser-only static shell fails it. cw_custom_document_surface (judge.toml:23) mirrors the public rule in environment/instructions/ui.md:3 (no textarea/input/contenteditable document surface, named ready-made editors, 'A small input solely for keyboard or clipboard plumbing is fine') and explicitly passes DOM, canvas or SVG surfaces.

IN-DIMENSION GATE. scored/functional/prompt.md:5, scored/polish/prompt.md:5 and scored/visual/prompt.md:5 carry the identical sentence 'Global browser gate: before scoring, confirm in the live browser that the application loads from http://localhost:3000 without a fatal browser error and that text typed into the code editor appears in it. External font, script or CDN asset requests are allowed. If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension.' That is a hard zero, not partial credit; visual/prompt.md:7 keeps it consistent with the likert anchors ('Apart from a failed global browser gate, 0 is used only when the thing being judged is not shown at all').

AUTH LEG. Not applicable and correctly dropped from the template wording: instruction.md:5 'without signing in', policy.md:3 'without sign-in or private accounts', app_context.md:10 'None. The app has no sign-in'.

SAME-ORIGIN. No gate or scored prompt requires same-origin; all five prompts say external font, script or CDN requests are allowed (render prompt.md:5, constraints prompt.md:5, the three scored prompt.md:5, app_context.md:30), matching integration.md:5. The only 'origin' wording in the gate is clearing this origin's browser storage, which is a persistence probe, not an asset-origin rule.

COUNTEREXAMPLES TRIED. (a) Blank page or error page: fails render, reward 0, scored suite skipped. (b) Static shell with a non-typeable mock editor: fails render and every in-dimension gate. (c) Own-surface editor that types but keeps snippets only in localStorage/IndexedDB: passes render and the in-dimension gate, fails cw_shared_saved_record after storage is cleared, reward 0. (d) Textarea or CodeMirror app with a real server: fails cw_custom_document_surface on a public requirement. (e) Conforming alternatives: a canvas editor, an editor with a hidden textarea receiving keys, an app whose draft starts with a small example, and an app that asks for confirmation before a reload discards a draft all pass the gate wording as written (app_context.md:22 tells the judge that accepting that dialog is normal). I found no conforming app that the gate text fails and no dead app that it passes.

NOTES (not defects). 1. The in-dimension gate sentence restates load-and-type only; it has no backing leg, so on its own it would not zero case (c). This matches the template, whose in-dimension gate also carries only load plus sign-in, and the backing leg is carried by the real constraints gate, which test.sh enforces before the scored suite can run; functional also grades storage-clearing, two-tab and restart persistence. 2. The storage-clearing list in app_context.md:25 does not cover window.name, so a deliberately adversarial browser-only app could survive the two reloads of the constraints gate; it would still fail the functional two-context and restart criteria, so the effect is bounded and I do not treat it as a credible failure of this row.

MEASUREMENT. Evidence-index hashes verified for results/runtime.json (e47b63b0...), results/editor.json (0e98f453...), results/persist-before.json (2fb23df0...) and tests/smoke.cjs (8d68aa40...). Scripted golden on these bytes reports cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing true (runtime.json), cw_custom_document_surface true (polish.json) and cw_shared_saved_record true (persist-before.json). The hosted run in which both gates passed was on an earlier candidate whose render gate was a different criterion; the index states 'No configured judge run exists for these bytes'. So how the configured judge applies the reduced render gate and the three in-dimension gate sentences is unmeasured, which is why risk stays true.
